It gets you started w"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ith zero code or configuration and installs every dependency for you with one click."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Pasting an image works two ways. **① Just paste.** On a text-only model the pasted image lands as a "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"private temp file and its path enters the composer (the same interaction OpenCode and Pi ship), then"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" the `modlens_read_image` tool takes it from there. **② Pick a `(modlens vision)` entry** in the mod"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"el selector (it remembers your choice, so once is enough), then paste: the thumbnail stays visible i"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"n your message, closer to the Codex app feel, and the image is converted to structured evidence at r"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"equest time, answered by the same underlying route. A s"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"tock install gets **`DeepSeek-V4-Flash (modlens vision)`** and **`DeepSeek-V4-Pro (modlens vision)`*"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"*, while extra routes like opencode-go or zai get their own. Native vision models in those families,"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" including GLM-5.3-Flash, are excluded automatically. Uninstalling is deleting a folder, and your agents are back to stock.
